Resonator War.note: A 3.8 war report describes the Federated Cities' government forces fighting a Resonator army, whereas this introduction places the Resonator side in the Federated Cities. The report is one in-world account, so the tension is noted rather than resolved.

Fifth Sector.note: A 3.8 war report describes the Federated Cities' government forces fighting a Resonator army, whereas this introduction calls the occupying force the Federated Cities' Resonator army. The report is one in-world account, so the tension is noted rather than resolved.
